children: Qatar’s Public Works Authority (Ashghal) is expected to award a design-and-build contract for the MIA Dhow and Floating Jetty Project in Doha in the first quarter of 2027, a source aware of the details said.

The tender was issued on 25 August 2026, with bids due on 11 October 2026.“The contract is expected to be awarded in January 2027,” the source told Zawya Projects, adding that it is scheduled for completion in the third quarter of 2028.

The project comprises works at two sites.At the MIA floating jetty site, the scope includes demolition and dismantling of the existing structure, installation of steel piles and pile caps, and supply and installation of a new floating jetty.
It also covers electrical, lighting, mechanical and architectural works; electricity and water utilities; and installation of marine-grade stainless-steel jetty hooks and rubber fenders.

The second site covers facilities for the National Collection's traditional dhow vessels. Works include demolition and dismantling, as well as the relocation and refurbishment of existing shade structures, temporary cabins and car park shades.

The scope also includes boundary walls, substrata and paving, infrastructure works, storage facilities, access control and security systems, electrical and mechanical works, maritime engineering and slipway facilities, a jetty, wave breaker and loading dock, a land-access walkway, and a substation and electrical connection.
(Reporting by Deva Palanisamy; Editing by Anoop Menon)

title: Qatar’s Ashghal expected to award jetty, dhow facilities contract in Q1 2027
